user.title: Set up Spot Charge Scheduler
user.description: Pick the entities that control/report your vehicle's charging.

data.energy_added_sensor_entity: Energy added sensor (optional, enables self-calibrating capacity)
data.location_tracker_entity: Vehicle location tracker (optional, together with the zone below only charges while home)
data.home_zone_entity: Zone the vehicle must be in to charge (optional, requires the tracker above)
data.tibber_home_nickname: Tibber home nickname (as shown in the Tibber app)
data.battery_capacity_kwh_default: Battery capacity (kWh) — starting estimate, refined automatically over time
